  "title": "Sustainability Operations Manager",
  "description": "Johnvents Trading, a subsidiary of Johnvents Group, is a leading Nigerian agribusiness and manufacturing company, driving sustainable growth across the agricultural value chain. With a strong presence in Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC), we source and trade premium commodities like soybeans, Sesame, Cashew and cocoa products across Africa, Asia, and Europe.

We are seeking talented individuals to join our dynamic team and build a career in international trade and agribusiness in the capacity below:

Job Position: Sustainability Operations Manager

Job Location: Akure, Ondo
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Purpose


	The Sustainability Operations Manager - Nigeria is responsible for the day-to-day management, execution, and tracking of all sustainability programmes and projects across commodities and sourcing areas in Nigeria.
	The role holder&#39;s job is to make sure the agreed work plans actually get delivered - on time, within budget, with progress visible every week, and with issues resolved at country level before they escalate.
	The ideal candidate is a hands-on operations or project management professional who is smart at execution: someone who takes a defined target, mobilises the right people, tracks progress rigorously, removes blockers, and gets things done.


Key Responsibilities
Project &amp; Work Plan Management:


	Own the execution of the Nigeria sustainability work plan across all commodities (cocoa, cashew, palm kernel, soya, sesame) and all workstreams (mapping, certification, CLMRS, farmer programmes, new commodity rollout).
	Break annual and half-year plans into clear weekly and monthly milestones per workstream and per team, with named owners, deadlines, and deliverables.
	Run all workstreams in parallel, ensuring each team is progressing against its own targets every week - no workstream stalls while waiting for another.
	Anticipate delays and blockers early, resolve them at country level, and escalate to the Group Sustainability Supply Chain Manager with a clear problem statement and proposed solution.
	&bull;Maintain a single, up-to-date view of the status of every project, programme, and partner commitment in Nigeria at any point in time.


Progress Monitoring &amp; Tracking:


	Track weekly field milestones across all commodities (farmer registration, training, GPS / polygon mapping, certification activities, CLMRS rollout), keeping at least 90% of milestones on schedule.
	Maintain and continuously update trackers for all workstreams, and submit a consolidated weekly progress report every Monday covering progress, deviations, and corrective actions.
	Ensure all field data and programme records are complete, organised, and audit-ready at all times, working with the M&amp;E / data lead.
	Flag underperformance against milestones immediately with a recovery plan.


Team Coordination &amp; Delivery Management:


	Coordinate the in-country pillar/technical leads and field supervisors day to day, translating strategy into clear task assignments and deadlines.
	Get delivery through others: know who the go-to person is for each pillar (certification, EUDR, CLMRS, data / M&amp;E, community programmes) and hold them accountable for their targets.
	Ensure every team member has defined, tracked KPIs, and support monthly performance reviews with objective, evidence-based input on delivery.
	Support onboarding, field planning, and logistics for team activities, including field visit schedules, movement plans, and cost-efficient routing.


Budget Tracking &amp; Cost Control:


	Track budget utilisation across all Nigeria sustainability programmes against the approved annual budget, maintaining continuous visibility of spend per workstream.
	Prepare and submit the following month&#39;s budget and submit a monthly variance report with explanations and corrective actions.
	Verify all per diem, allowance, and field cost claims are policy-compliant, pre-approved, and supported by documentation before payment.
	Drive cost optimisation continuously - challenge transport, logistics, and activity costs, and propose cheaper ways to deliver the same results (cost per farmer, cost per MT).


Procurement &amp; Cross-Functional Coordination:


	Act as the primary link between the sustainability team and procurement teams across all commodities.
	Work with procurement to introduce sustainability activities into sourcing areas through the procurement route.
	Coordinate with finance, admin, and site teams to ensure field operations, payments, and logistics run without delays.
	Coordinate access to relevant internal reports and dashboards (e.g. farm and expense dashboards) to inform planning and cost control.


Compliance &amp; Field Standards Support:


	Ensure field teams follow agreed protocols for farmer registration, training delivery, mapping, monitoring, and documentation.
	Support the timely execution of compliance-related activities (certification audits, CLMRS rollout, E&amp;S action plan items) as scheduled in the work plan, coordinating the responsible technical leads.
	Ensure 100% on-time submission of scheduled internal and external reports.


Regional Support:


	Provide operational support to new country programmes as required - travel, field coordination, tracking, and reporting support - under the direction of the Group Sustainability Supply Chain Manager.


Key Performance Indicators


	At least 90% of weekly milestones across all workstreams delivered on schedule; consolidated progress report submitted every Monday without fail.
	100% of projects tracked with up-to-date status, owners, and deadlines at all times.
	Budget variance held within plus or minus 5% with monthly variance reporting; year-on-year improvement in cost per farmer and cost per MT.
	100% of field data and claims verified before sign-off or payment; zero unapproved claims.
	Zero missed reporting deadlines (internal, partner, donor, TA).
	Partner and TA coordination issues resolved at country level; escalations only with problem statement and proposed solution.
	Functional working relationship with procurement teams across all commodities, evidenced by joint activities in sourcing areas.


Requirements
Qualifications &amp; Experience:


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Agriculture, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of experience in operations, procurement, field operations, supply chain, or project management - ideally in agricultural commodities, FMCG, agro-processing, or field-based programmes in Nigeria.
	Proven track record of delivering projects or operational targets on time and within budget, and of managing multiple parallel workstreams.
	Strong experience with planning, tracking, and reporting tools - excellent Excel skills (trackers, budgets, variance analysis) are essential.
	Experience in budget management, cost control, and expense verification.
	Experience working with or within procurement teams and sourcing operations is a strong advantage.
	Knowledge of sustainability, certification, or donor-funded programmes is an advantage but not a requirement
	Willingness to be based in Akure and to travel extensively to rural sourcing areas across Nigeria, with occasional regional travel.


Competencies &amp; Personal Attributes:


	Execution Focus - gets things done; converts plans into delivered results without needing to be chased; comfortable being measured on delivery, not effort.
	Organisation &amp; Tracking Discipline - rigorous with trackers, milestones, deadlines, and follow-ups; nothing falls through the cracks.
	Problem Solving &amp; Resourcefulness - anticipates blockers, finds practical solutions at country level, and escalates with solutions rather than problems.
	Coordination &amp; Follow-Through - works effectively through others, holds people to deadlines, and keeps multiple teams moving in parallel.
	Cost Consciousness - treats company resources as their own; constantly looks for cheaper, faster ways to deliver the same results.
	Integrity &amp; Attention to Detail - rigorous with data, documentation, verification, and compliance; zero tolerance for unverified claims.
	Coachability &amp; Willingness to Learn - open to learning sustainability concepts on the job; takes direction well and applies it quickly.
	Collaboration - builds practical working relationships across procurement, finance, field teams, and external partners.

	Ensure every team member has defined, tracked KPIs, and support monthly performance reviews with objective, evidence-based input on delivery.
	Support onboarding, field planning, and logistics for team activities, including field visit schedules, movement plans, and cost-efficient routing.


Budget Tracking & Cost Control:


	Track budget utilisation across all Nigeria sustainability programmes against the approved annual budget, maintaining continuous visibility of spend per workstream.
	Prepare and submit the following month's budget and submit a monthly variance report with explanations and corrective actions.
	Verify all per diem, allowance, and field cost claims are policy-compliant, pre-approved, and supported by documentation before payment.
	Drive cost optimisation continuously - challenge transport, logistics, and activity costs, and propose cheaper ways to deliver the same results (cost per farmer, cost per MT).


Procurement & Cross-Functional Coordination:


	Act as the primary link between the sustainability team and procurement teams across all commodities.
	Work with procurement to introduce sustainability activities into sourcing areas through the procurement route.
	Coordinate with finance, admin, and site teams to ensure field operations, payments, and logistics run without delays.
	Coordinate access to relevant internal reports and dashboards (e.g. farm and expense dashboards) to inform planning and cost control.


Compliance & Field Standards Support:


	Ensure field teams follow agreed protocols for farmer registration, training delivery, mapping, monitoring, and documentation.
	Support the timely execution of compliance-related activities (certification audits, CLMRS rollout, E&S action plan items) as scheduled in the work plan, coordinating the responsible technical leads.
	Ensure 100% on-time submission of scheduled internal and external reports.


Regional Support:


	Provide operational support to new country programmes as required - travel, field coordination, tracking, and reporting support - under the direction of the Group Sustainability Supply Chain Manager.


Key Performance Indicators


	At least 90% of weekly milestones across all workstreams delivered on schedule; consolidated progress report submitted every Monday without fail.
	100% of projects tracked with up-to-date status, owners, and deadlines at all times.
	Budget variance held within plus or minus 5% with monthly variance reporting; year-on-year improvement in cost per farmer and cost per MT.
	100% of field data and claims verified before sign-off or payment; zero unapproved claims.
	Zero missed reporting deadlines (internal, partner, donor, TA).
	Partner and TA coordination issues resolved at country level; escalations only with problem statement and proposed solution.
	Functional working relationship with procurement teams across all commodities, evidenced by joint activities in sourcing areas.


Requirements
Qualifications & Experience:


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Agriculture, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of experience in operations, procurement, field operations, supply chain, or project management - ideally in agricultural commodities, FMCG, agro-processing, or field-based programmes in Nigeria.
	Proven track record of delivering projects or operational targets on time and within budget, and of managing multiple parallel workstreams.
	Strong experience with planning, tracking, and reporting tools - excellent Excel skills (trackers, budgets, variance analysis) are essential.
	Experience in budget management, cost control, and expense verification.
	Experience working with or within procurement teams and sourcing operations is a strong advantage.
	Knowledge of sustainability, certification, or donor-funded programmes is an advantage but not a requirement
	Willingness to be based in Akure and to travel extensively to rural sourcing areas across Nigeria, with occasional regional travel.


Competencies & Personal Attributes:


	Execution Focus - gets things done; converts plans into delivered results without needing to be chased; comfortable being measured on delivery, not effort.
	Organisation & Tracking Discipline - rigorous with trackers, milestones, deadlines, and follow-ups; nothing falls through the cracks.
	Problem Solving & Resourcefulness - anticipates blockers, finds practical solutions at country level, and escalates with solutions rather than problems.
	Coordination & Follow-Through - works effectively through others, holds people to deadlines, and keeps multiple teams moving in parallel.
	Cost Consciousness - treats company resources as their own; constantly looks for cheaper, faster ways to deliver the same results.
	Integrity & Attention to Detail - rigorous with data, documentation, verification, and compliance; zero tolerance for unverified claims.
	Coachability & Willingness to Learn - open to learning sustainability concepts on the job; takes direction well and applies it quickly.
	Collaboration - builds practical working relationships across procurement, finance, field teams, and external partners.

With a strong presence in Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC), we source and trade premium commodities like soybeans, Sesame, Cashew and cocoa products across Africa, Asia, and Europe.

We are seeking talented individuals to join our dynamic team and build a career in international trade and agribusiness in the capacity below:

Job Position: Purchase Accountant

Job Location: Kano
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Purchase Accountant is responsible for managing and recording all Commodity purchase-related financial transactions, ensuring accuracy in accounts payable, Pre-payments and maintaining compliance with company policies and accounting standards.
	This role involves close coordination with the procurement team and internal departments to ensure timely and accurate processing of Pre-payments, purchase orders and invoices.


Key Responsibilities


	Pre-payments: Processing prepayments for the commodity purchases against the contracts and approvals from BUH
	Invoice Processing: Verify, record, and reconcile supplier invoices against purchase orders and delivery notes.
	Accounts Payable Management: Maintain accurate accounts payable ledger and ensure timely payments to vendors and setting off of the pre-payments against the invoice
	Purchase Order Control: Monitor and validate purchase orders for accuracy and compliance with budget and company policies.
	Vendor Coordination: Communicate with suppliers regarding discrepancies, payment schedules, and account statements.
	Expense Recording : ensure proper recording of expenses to respective business unit and appropriate Business products and commodity.
	Petty Cash Management: Maintaining the petty cash for the Branch and ensuring proper recording of the transactions in the ERP.
	Compliance & Documentation: Ensure all purchase transactions comply with tax regulations, internal controls, and audit requirements.
	Reporting: Prepare periodic reports on petty Cash expenses, Pre-payments and Purchase performance.
	Reconciliation: Perform reconciliation of supplier accounts and resolve discrepancies promptly.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
	Proven experience in accounts payable or purchase accounting (typically 3–5 years).
	Strong knowledge of accounting principles and ERP systems (SAP, Netsuite, Tally, etc.).
	Proficiency in MS Excel and financial reporting tools.
	Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

	Analytical thinking and problem-solving.

	Assist with staff attendance, leave records, and payroll documentation.
	Organize staff training, meetings, and employee engagement activities.
	Respond to employee inquiries regarding HR policies and procedures.
	Ensure confidentiality of employee information and HR records.
	Assist in implementing HR policies and maintaining compliance with company procedures.

	Interested candidates should possess an SSCE, FSLC, or OND with 0-2 years of experience.
